info.title: SHAPI advisory twilio-notify-end-of-life
info.summary: Twilio Notify reaches end of life on 2027-01-31

workflows.summary: Shows the change: Twilio Notify (notify.twilio.com, e.g. POST /v1/Services/{ServiceSid}/Notifications) has been unsupported and closed to new customers since October 2022 and reaches end of life for existing customers on 2027-01-31, per Twilio's Help Center (superseding the 2025-12-31 date in the January 2024 changelog). Push sent through Verify, Voice, Conversations or Engage is not affected.

steps.description: POST /v1/Services/{ServiceSid}/Notifications fails from 2027-01-31: the operation is shut down
